_comment: Trainable problem -> resolution map for the iPay bot. Edit this file to teach (or update) how the bot resolves user problems in the Issues menu and in AI answers. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Each entry may have: title, resolution (step-by-step), keywords (used for guide search), and escalate (bool, default true).

deposit.title: Deposit / Payment Not Reflected
deposit.resolution:
◆ iPAY – DEPOSIT ISSUE

➡️ IMPORTANT CHECKS
▪️ Check the payment details and order expiry.
▪️ Use your iPay-linked wallet only.
▪️ Do not use Pocket UPI.

🎯 NEXT STEPS
✅ Paid? Submit your UTR and payment screenshot.
⏳ Payment pending? Check the status before paying again.
📞 Still facing issues? Contact iPay support.

◆ CHECK FIRST – PAY SAFELY!

withdrawal.title: Delayed Withdrawal
withdrawal.resolution:
🧾 iPAY – DELAYED WITHDRAWAL

➡️ IMPORTANT CHECKS
▪️ Check your daily UPI receiving limit.
▪️ Make sure UPI is active.
▪️ Ensure your bank account can receive payments.
▪️ Check your wallet connection.
▪️ Try relinking your wallet if needed.

🎯 WHAT TO DO
▪️ ⏳ Wait for the status update.
▪️ 📞 Contact iPay support if the delay continues.

◆ CHECK • VERIFY • STAY UPDATED!

rewards.title: Missing Reward
rewards.resolution:
MISSING REWARD

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- Review the offer's eligibility and completion conditions in the app.
- Check your progress and the reward status.
- Ask support to clarify any task threshold or calculation.

WHAT TO DO NEXT
- A task threshold is not a separate unlocking fee; do not pay anyone to unlock a reward.
- Ask support to check the missing reward.

commission.title: Commission Discrepancy
commission.resolution:
COMMISSION

KEY POINTS
- Rates and bonuses can vary by offer and completed order.
- Check the current commission details in the app before starting.

WHAT TO DO NEXT
- Ask support to confirm the rate or eligibility for a specific order.

upi.title: UPI Blocked / Locked
upi.resolution:
UPI BLOCKED OR LOCKED

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- Check the wallet status and follow the instructions shown in the iPay app.
- Contact your bank or wallet provider if they show a restriction.

IMPORTANT
- Avoid repeated attempts while the account is locked.
- Only make a ₹1 transfer to your own UPI if the app instructs you to.
- Contact support if the issue remains.

locked.title: Order Locked
locked.resolution:
ORDER LOCKED

WHAT TO DO NEXT
- Check the wallet status and follow the instructions in the iPay app.
- Do not log in through third-party apps or make duplicate payments.
- Ask support what to do before changing or reconnecting the wallet.

account.title: Account / Password Issue
account.resolution:
ACCOUNT ACCESS

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- If signed in, use the password-change option in your account settings and follow the verification steps.
- If you cannot sign in, contact support for account-recovery help.

IMPORTANT
- Never share your password, OTP, or PIN here.
